options.content:
IO pressure is Linux PSI: the share of wall time in which tasks were stalled waiting for block IO. **Some** means at least one task was stalled; **full** means every non-idle task was stalled at once, so the workload made no progress; **full** is never above **some**. The **IO stall** picker switches the node and pod graphs between the two; the pod table shows both. Node PSI comes from node-exporter (`node_pressure_io_*`); pod PSI comes from cAdvisor's pod-level cgroup (`container_pressure_io_*{container=""}`). Pod values are not additive: two pods stalled at the same instant each show 100%.

The node list is the nodes whose node-exporter reports PSI; the disk rows at the bottom repeat once per selected node. Disk panels come from node-exporter `node_disk_*`, mapped to the Kubernetes node via the node-exporter pod. `hdd`/`ssd` is the kernel's per-device rotational flag from `node_disk_info`; virtual disks (`vd*`) usually report rotational regardless of what backs them. Device-mapper, DRBD, loop and optical devices are left out of physical-device panels. The separate DRBD logical throughput panel overlaps backing-device I/O and must not be added to physical throughput. Latency is the mean service time per completed request over 5 minutes, empty when nothing completed; utilization is the fraction of time the device had IO in flight, which saturates at 100% on a spinning disk but not reliably on SSDs with deep queues.

panels.title: Node IO stall: ${stall:text}
panels.description: Share of time tasks on the node waited on IO; the IO stall picker at the top switches between some and full.

targets.expr: max by (node) (rate(node_pressure_io_${stall}_seconds_total[5m]) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="monitoring",pod=~"prometheus-node-exporter-.+",node=~"$node"}))

panels.title: Top pods by IO stall: ${stall:text}
panels.description: Pod cgroup PSI from cAdvisor; the ${topk} pods with the highest current value.

targets.expr: topk(${topk}, max by (namespace, pod, node) (rate(container_pressure_io_${stall}_seconds_total{container="", pod!="", node=~"$node"}[5m])))

panels.title: Pods by IO stall now
panels.description: Current 5-minute pod PSI. Rows are the ${topk} pods with the highest 'some' stall.

targets.expr: topk(${topk}, max by (namespace, pod, node) (rate(container_pressure_io_waiting_seconds_total{container="", pod!="", node=~"$node"}[5m])))
topk(1000, max by (namespace, pod, node) (rate(container_pressure_io_stalled_seconds_total{container="", pod!="", node=~"$node"}[5m])))

panels.title: Disks now
panels.description: Current 5-minute values per disk. Latency is empty for a disk with no completed requests in the window.

targets.expr: max by (node, media, device) (((rate(node_disk_io_time_seconds_total{device!~"^(loop|ram|fd|dm-|sr|nbd|drbd).*"}[5m])) * on (namespace, pod, device) group_left (media) label_replace(label_replace(max by (namespace, pod, device, rotational) (node_disk_info), "media", "hdd", "rotational", "1"), "media", "ssd", "rotational", "0")) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="monitoring",pod=~"prometheus-node-exporter-.+",node=~"$node"}))

max by (node, media, device) (((rate(node_disk_read_time_seconds_total{device!~"^(loop|ram|fd|dm-|sr|nbd|drbd).*"}[5m]) / rate(node_disk_reads_completed_total{device!~"^(loop|ram|fd|dm-|sr|nbd|drbd).*"}[5m])) * on (namespace, pod, device) group_left (media) label_replace(label_replace(max by (namespace, pod, device, rotational) (node_disk_info), "media", "hdd", "rotational", "1"), "media", "ssd", "rotational", "0")) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="monitoring",pod=~"prometheus-node-exporter-.+",node=~"$node"}))

max by (node, media, device) (((rate(node_disk_write_time_seconds_total{device!~"^(loop|ram|fd|dm-|sr|nbd|drbd).*"}[5m]) / rate(node_disk_writes_completed_total{device!~"^(loop|ram|fd|dm-|sr|nbd|drbd).*"}[5m])) * on (namespace, pod, device) group_left (media) label_replace(label_replace(max by (namespace, pod, device, rotational) (node_disk_info), "media", "hdd", "rotational", "1"), "media", "ssd", "rotational", "0")) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="monitoring",pod=~"prometheus-node-exporter-.+",node=~"$node"}))

max by (node, media, device) (((rate(node_disk_reads_completed_total{device!~"^(loop|ram|fd|dm-|sr|nbd|drbd).*"}[5m]) + rate(node_disk_writes_completed_total{device!~"^(loop|ram|fd|dm-|sr|nbd|drbd).*"}[5m])) * on (namespace, pod, device) group_left (media) label_replace(label_replace(max by (namespace, pod, device, rotational) (node_disk_info), "media", "hdd", "rotational", "1"), "media", "ssd", "rotational", "0")) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="monitoring",pod=~"prometheus-node-exporter-.+",node=~"$node"}))

panels.title: Utilization now
panels.description: Fraction of the last 5 minutes each disk had IO in flight.

targets.expr: max by (node, media, device) (((rate(node_disk_io_time_seconds_total{device!~"^(loop|ram|fd|dm-|sr|nbd|drbd).*"}[5m])) * on (namespace, pod, device) group_left (media) label_replace(label_replace(max by (namespace, pod, device, rotational) (node_disk_info), "media", "hdd", "rotational", "1"), "media", "ssd", "rotational", "0")) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="monitoring",pod=~"prometheus-node-exporter-.+",node=~"$node"}))

panels.title: Disk utilization
panels.description: Fraction of time the device had IO in flight (node_disk_io_time_seconds_total).

targets.expr: max by (node, media, device) (((rate(node_disk_io_time_seconds_total{device!~"^(loop|ram|fd|dm-|sr|nbd|drbd).*"}[5m])) * on (namespace, pod, device) group_left (media) label_replace(label_replace(max by (namespace, pod, device, rotational) (node_disk_info), "media", "hdd", "rotational", "1"), "media", "ssd", "rotational", "0")) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="monitoring",pod=~"prometheus-node-exporter-.+",node=~"$node"}))

panels.title: Disk read latency
panels.description: Mean time per completed read over 5 minutes.

targets.expr: max by (node, media, device) (((rate(node_disk_read_time_seconds_total{device!~"^(loop|ram|fd|dm-|sr|nbd|drbd).*"}[5m]) / rate(node_disk_reads_completed_total{device!~"^(loop|ram|fd|dm-|sr|nbd|drbd).*"}[5m])) * on (namespace, pod, device) group_left (media) label_replace(label_replace(max by (namespace, pod, device, rotational) (node_disk_info), "media", "hdd", "rotational", "1"), "media", "ssd", "rotational", "0")) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="monitoring",pod=~"prometheus-node-exporter-.+",node=~"$node"}))

panels.title: Disk write latency
panels.description: Mean time per completed write over 5 minutes.

targets.expr: max by (node, media, device) (((rate(node_disk_write_time_seconds_total{device!~"^(loop|ram|fd|dm-|sr|nbd|drbd).*"}[5m]) / rate(node_disk_writes_completed_total{device!~"^(loop|ram|fd|dm-|sr|nbd|drbd).*"}[5m])) * on (namespace, pod, device) group_left (media) label_replace(label_replace(max by (namespace, pod, device, rotational) (node_disk_info), "media", "hdd", "rotational", "1"), "media", "ssd", "rotational", "0")) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="monitoring",pod=~"prometheus-node-exporter-.+",node=~"$node"}))

panels.title: Disk IOPS
panels.description: Completed reads plus writes per second.

targets.expr: max by (node, media, device) (((rate(node_disk_reads_completed_total{device!~"^(loop|ram|fd|dm-|sr|nbd|drbd).*"}[5m]) + rate(node_disk_writes_completed_total{device!~"^(loop|ram|fd|dm-|sr|nbd|drbd).*"}[5m])) * on (namespace, pod, device) group_left (media) label_replace(label_replace(max by (namespace, pod, device, rotational) (node_disk_info), "media", "hdd", "rotational", "1"), "media", "ssd", "rotational", "0")) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="monitoring",pod=~"prometheus-node-exporter-.+",node=~"$node"}))

panels.title: Disk throughput
panels.description: Bytes read plus written per second.

targets.expr: max by (node, media, device) (((rate(node_disk_read_bytes_total{device!~"^(loop|ram|fd|dm-|sr|nbd|drbd).*"}[5m]) + rate(node_disk_written_bytes_total{device!~"^(loop|ram|fd|dm-|sr|nbd|drbd).*"}[5m])) * on (namespace, pod, device) group_left (media) label_replace(label_replace(max by (namespace, pod, device, rotational) (node_disk_info), "media", "hdd", "rotational", "1"), "media", "ssd", "rotational", "0")) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="monitoring",pod=~"prometheus-node-exporter-.+",node=~"$node"}))

panels.title: Disk queue depth
panels.description: Average number of requests in flight (node_disk_io_time_weighted_seconds_total).

targets.expr: max by (node, media, device) (((rate(node_disk_io_time_weighted_seconds_total{device!~"^(loop|ram|fd|dm-|sr|nbd|drbd).*"}[5m])) * on (namespace, pod, device) group_left (media) label_replace(label_replace(max by (namespace, pod, device, rotational) (node_disk_info), "media", "hdd", "rotational", "1"), "media", "ssd", "rotational", "0")) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="monitoring",pod=~"prometheus-node-exporter-.+",node=~"$node"}))

panels.title: Logical throughput by node and device
panels.description: Read plus written bytes per second by DRBD device. This is logical block-device I/O and overlaps the backing physical devices; do not add it to physical throughput.

targets.expr: max by (node, device) ((rate(node_disk_read_bytes_total{device=~"^drbd.*"}[5m]) + rate(node_disk_written_bytes_total{device=~"^drbd.*"}[5m])) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="monitoring",pod=~"prometheus-node-exporter-.+",node=~"$node"}))

list.definition: query_result(max by (node) (node_pressure_io_stalled_seconds_total * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="monitoring",pod=~"prometheus-node-exporter-.+"})))
list.label: Node
list.name: node
list.query: query_result(max by (node) (node_pressure_io_stalled_seconds_total * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="monitoring",pod=~"prometheus-node-exporter-.+"})))
